Data extraction: TOML table section becomes a container KeyValue node

```go title="Go"
package main

import (
	"fmt"
	tspack "github.com/xberg-io/tree-sitter-language-pack/packages/go"
)

func main() {
	config := tspack.ProcessConfig{
		Language:       `toml`,
		DataExtraction: true,
	}
	result, err := tspack.Process(`[server]
host = "localhost"
port = 8080
`, config)
	if err != nil {
		panic(err)
	}
	fmt.Printf("%+v\n", result.Data)
	fmt.Printf("%+v\n", result.Data.Children)
}
```
